comment: Accelerated-simulation variant, for runner.demo ONLY. REMORA measures limit windows on its own wall clock, while the demo compresses a simulated day into minutes; the production budgets (ot_limits.policy.json) would then refuse a normal day's changes as if they happened within one real hour (found 2026-10-27). Here the zone-01/02 window is 60 s with the same 4.0 degC budget, which bounds movement per simulated controller step at the demo's pace. Cumulative-limit behaviour itself is demonstrated in real time by the acceptance case LIM-01 with the production policy, never by this file.
